requests.name: escape_char_in_content
requests.description: Attempt injection via ESC character (U+001B) in content field

requests.name: mixed_control_chars_in_space_id
requests.description: Attempt injection via multiple control characters in space_id

requests.name: form_feed_in_content
requests.description: Attempt injection via form feed (U+000C) in content
